summary: WESCO International filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026 covering amendments to two credit facilities dated September 17, 2026. Wholly owned subsidiary Wesco Distribution extended its ABL revolving facility maturity to September 17, 2031, raised commitments from $1,725 million to $1,850 million, and reduced interest spreads. Separately, it amended its receivables securitization facility, extending the termination date to September 17, 2029 and increasing the purchase limit from $1,550 million to $1,750 million. No equity, deal, or special-situation event is involved; this is routine financing documentation with Barclays and PNC as agents.
